definition: Reconstructing a high-resolution image from a low-resolution input by hallucinating plausible detail.
details: Reconstructing a high-resolution image from a low-resolution input by hallucinating plausible detail. CNNs, GANs (SRGAN), and diffusion models push the fidelity frontier used in imaging and upscaling.

explainer.lead: Image super-resolution reconstructs a high-resolution image from a low-resolution input by hallucinating plausible detail. CNNs, GANs such as SRGAN, and diffusion models push the fidelity frontier for imaging and upscaling.

tiers.eli5: Like guessing the missing fine detail when you enlarge a small photo so it looks sharp.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers upscale with CNN, GAN or diffusion models; a common pitfall is that the added detail is hallucinated and may not match the true scene.
tiers.paperLevel: Reconstructing a high-resolution image from a low-resolution input by hallucinating plausible detail; CNNs, GANs (SRGAN), and diffusion models push the fidelity frontier.

explainer.example: Upscaling a low-resolution image to high resolution with a GAN such as SRGAN.
